mapper.select:
SELECT 'CYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, t.dec_qic as periods, t.dt_riq as planDate, t.dec_shijzj as rentAmount, t.dec_benj as principalAmount, t.dec_lix as interestAmount from hengyuncar.cy_pm_zujjhb t left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join hengyuncar.cy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join hengyuncar.CY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and not exists (select zc.vc_hethm from hengyuncar.cy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm) and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and h.vc_hethm in
#{item}
order by h.vc_hethm, t.dec_qic

SELECT 'CYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hetgs AS orgId, h.vc_hethm as contractCode, max(t.dec_qic) as periods, max(t.dt_riq) as planDate, sum(t.dec_shijzj) as rentAmount, sum(t.dec_benj) as principalAmount, sum(t.dec_lix) as interestAmount from hengyuncar.cy_pm_zujjhb t left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = t.vc_hetbid left join hengyuncar.cy_cm_hetgrgfb ch on ch.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and ch.vc_zhongl = '0' left join hengyuncar.CY_OP_YuQXXB yq on yq.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid and yq.vc_shifwj = '0' left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_rongzxxb rz on rz.vc_hetbid = h.vc_hetbid where t.dec_qic is not null and t.dec_qic <> 0 and not exists (select zc.vc_hethm from hengyuncar.cy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm) and h.vc_hetztm in ('1','10','13','2','4','5','6','7')
and h.vc_hethm in
#{item}
GROUP BY h.vc_hetgs, h.vc_hethm, to_char(t.dt_riq, 'yyyy-MM') order by h.vc_hethm, max(t.dt_riq)

SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID , rownum rn FROM ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM hengyuncar.rpt_firr_new GROUP BY contract_id HAVING TRUNC(max(PLAN_DATE)) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY CONTRACT_ID ) WHERE rownum <= #{params.end} ) WHERE rn > #{params.start}

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'CYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 max(a.plan_list) as periods, -- 期项 max(a.plan_date) as planDate, -- 承付日期 sum(a.rent) as rentAmount, --租金 sum(a.net_flow) as cashFlow, --净流量 sum(a.naf_cut) as principalAmount, --本金 sum(a.interest) as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM hengyuncar.rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
group by a.contract_id, to_char(a.plan_date, 'yyyy-MM'), b.vc_hetgs ORDER BY a.contract_id, max(a.plan_date)

SELECT b.vc_hetgs AS orgId, 'CYCXT' as systemCode, -- 业务系统编号 a.contract_id as contractCode, --合同编号 a.plan_list as periods, -- 期项 a.plan_date as planDate, -- 承付日期 a.rent as rentAmount, --租金 a.net_flow as cashFlow, --净流量 a.naf_cut as principalAmount, --本金 a.interest as interestAmount --租息 -- 签约主体 -- IRR Rate -- a.inter_day nu_interday, -- 当期承付日期与上期承付日期相差的天数 -- a.interest_day dec_rilx, --日利息 -- a.interest_date dt_dangqzhyt, -- 当期最后一天 -- a.up_day nu_upday, --当期承付日期距上月最后一天的天数 -- a.down_day nu_downday, --当期承付日期距当月最后一天的天数 -- a.interest_cal dec_hanslx, -- 含税利息 -- a.interest_cal_aftertax dec_buhslx, --不含税利息 -- SYSDATE dt_chuangjsj -- 创建时间 FROM hengyuncar.rpt_firr_new a
LEFT JOIN hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb b ON a.CONTRACT_ID = b.vc_hethm WHERE b.vc_hetgs IS NOT null
and a.contract_id in
#{item}
ORDER BY a.contract_id, a.plan_list

select 'CYCXT' as systemCode, h.vc_hethm AS contractCode, t.dec_qic AS periods, t.DT_RiQ AS planDate, f.dec_yisfje as actualRepaymentRentAmount, f.dec_yisje as actualRepaymentPrincipalAmount, f.dec_yislx as actualRepaymentInteresAmount
from hengyuncar.CY_PM_ZUJJHB t left join hengyuncar.CY_FM_ShouFKB f on t.vc_hetbid = f.VC_WAIJID and t.dec_qic = f.dec_qis and f.vc_xianjlxm = '100009' inner join hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb h on h.vc_hetbid = f.VC_WAIJID where not exists ( select zc.vc_hethm from hengyuncar.cy_op_ziczrqdb zc where zc.vc_hethm = h.vc_hethm )
and h.vc_hethm in
#{item}
order by to_Number(Dec_qic)

select t.vc_wangybh ebank_batch_no, --业务系统批扣流水号 t.vc_pingzzy ebank_serial_number, --业务系统网银编号/批次号 t.vc_wangygs bank_org_id, --网银到账主体 --t.dec_ruzje, t.dec_weiczje ta_excess_balance, --TA/溢存款余额 t.vc_hethm contract_code, --合同编号 t.vc_xingm ebank_client_name, --网银付款人名称 ht.vc_hetgs org_id,--合同签约主体 t.vc_hetzt contract_status--合同状态 --t.vc_hethm_other, t.dec_weisfje, t.dec_weisfje_other --,case when ht.is_tianjin ='1' then '是' else '否' end tianjin --,case when ht.transflag ='1' then '是' else '否' end boyuan from hengyuncar.rpt_yick_info t left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb ht on t.vc_hethm = ht.vc_hethm --left join cy_pm_hetb ht on t.vc_hethm = ht.vc_hethm where to_char(t.his_date,'yyyy-MM') = substr(#{queryDate},1,7)

select * from ( select t.vc_wangybh as ebankSerialNumber, t.vc_pingzzy as ebankNumber, t.vc_wangygs as collectionAccountsBank, t.dec_ruzje as incomeAmount, t.dec_weiczje as nonOutcomeAmount, t.vc_hethm as contractCode, t.vc_xingm as clientName, t.vc_hetzt as contractStatus
from hengyuncar.rpt_yick_info t left join hengyuncar.cy_pm_hetb ht on t.vc_hethm = ht.vc_hethm where to_char(t.his_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} ) t where 1=1

select t.his_date, case when substr(t.vc_wangybh, 0, 3) = 'GHG' then t.vc_pich else t.vc_wangybh end as vc_wangybh, t.vc_pich, t.vc_wangyb_hy, t.vc_daozyh, t.vc_daozyhzh, t.vc_fukzh, t.dt_daodsj, t.dec_daozje, t.dec_kehxje, t.dec_yihxje, t.vc_beiz, t.vc_wangygs, t.vc_baozjgs, t.vc_spmc, t.vc_zhaiy from ( with tmp as ( select rp.* from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where rp.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.dt_daodsj >= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.vc_wangybh like 'CEB%' and vc_mark is null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' ) and dec_kehxje <> 0.00 ) select t.his_date, t.vc_pich vc_wangybh, t.vc_pich , to_char(t.vc_wangyb_hy) vc_wangyb_hy, t2.vc_daozyh, t2.vc_daozyhzh, t2.vc_fukzh, t2.dt_daodsj , t.dec_daozje, t.dec_kehxje, t.dec_daozje-t.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, null vc_beiz, t2.vc_wangygs, null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc , null vc_zhaiy from ( select t.his_date, t.vc_pich , sum(t.dec_daozje) dec_daozje, sum(t.dec_kehxje) dec_kehxje, sum(t.dec_daozje)-sum(t.dec_kehxje) dec_yihxje, wm_concat(t.vc_wangybh) vc_wangyb_hy from tmp t group by t.his_date, t.vc_pich ) t left join ( select * from ( select t2.vc_pich, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, w.dt_daodsj, te.codename vc_wangygs , row_number() over (partition by t2.vc_pich order by w.dt_daodsj desc) rown from tmp t2 left join hengyuncar.gy_fm_wangyjlb w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = t2.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyuncar.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' ) where rown = 1 ) t2 on t2.vc_pich = t.vc_pich union all select rp.his_date , case when rp.vc_wangybh like 'CEBM%' then rp.vc_pich else rp.vc_wangybh end vc_wangybh , rp.vc_pich, rp.vc_wangybh as vc_wangyb_hy, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, rp.dt_daodsj, rp.dec_daozje , rp.dec_kehxje, rp.dec_daozje-rp.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, rp.vc_mark vc_beiz, te.codename vc_wangygs, wybzj.vc_baozjgs, wybzj.vc_spmc, w.vc_zhaiy from ( select * from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where rp.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (rp.dt_daodsj < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') or rp.vc_wangybh not like 'CEB%') and vc_mark is null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and (kz.vc_pich like 'MS%' or kz.vc_wangybh like 'GHG%') ) and dec_kehxje <> 0.00 ) rp left join hengyuncar.gy_fm_wangyjlb w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyuncar.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' left join hengyuncar.cy_op_spbzjwyglb wybzj on wybzj.vc_wangybh = w.vc_wangybh union all select null, vc_wangybh, null, vc_wangybh as vc_wangyb_hy, null, null, null, null, dec_daozje, dec_kehxje, dec_daozje-dec_kehxje, vc_biz, null, null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc, null vc_zhaiy from hengyuncar.gy_fm_wangyjlb_none union all select t.his_date, t.vc_pich vc_wangybh, t.vc_pich, to_char(t.vc_wangyb_hy) vc_wangyb_hy , t2.vc_daozyh, t2.vc_daozyhzh, t2.vc_fukzh, t2.dt_daodsj , t.dec_daozje, t.dec_kehxje, t.dec_daozje-t.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, null vc_beiz, t2.vc_wangygs, null vc_baozjgs, null vc_spmc, null vc_zhaiy from ( select rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich, sum(rp.dec_daozje) dec_daozje, sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_kehxje, sum(rp.dec_daozje)-sum(rp.dec_kehxje) dec_yihxje, wm_concat(rp.vc_wangybh) vc_wangyb_hy from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.dt_daodsj >= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and rp.vc_wangybh like 'CEB%' and vc_mark is not null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%') and dec_kehxje <> 0.00 group by rp.his_date, rp.vc_pich ) t left join ( select * from ( select t2.vc_pich, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, w.dt_daodsj, te.codename vc_wangygs, row_number() over (partition by t2.vc_pich order by w.dt_daodsj desc) rown from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb t2 left join hengyuncar.gy_fm_wangyjlb w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = t2.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyuncar.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and t2.dt_daodsj >= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and t2.vc_wangybh like 'CEB%' and vc_mark is not null ) where rown = 1 ) t2 on t2.vc_pich = t.vc_pich union all select rp.his_date, case when rp.vc_wangybh like 'CEBM%' then rp.vc_pich else rp.vc_wangybh end vc_wangybh, rp.vc_pich, rp.vc_wangybh vc_wangyb_hy, w.vc_daozyh, w.vc_daozyhzh, w.vc_fukzh, rp.dt_daodsj, rp.dec_daozje , rp.dec_kehxje, rp.dec_daozje-rp.dec_kehxje dec_yihxje, rp.vc_mark vc_biz, te.codename vc_wangygs, wybzj.vc_baozjgs, wybzj.vc_spmc, w.vc_zhaiy from ( select * from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb rp where his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (rp.dt_daodsj < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') or rp.vc_wangybh not like 'CEB%') and vc_mark is not null and not exists ( select 1 from hengyuncar.rpt_fm_wangyjlb kz where kz.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid and kz.his_date = to_date(#{params.snapshootDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and to_char(kz.dt_daodsj, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{params.queryDate} and kz.vc_pich like 'MS%') and dec_kehxje <> 0.00 ) rp left join hengyuncar.gy_fm_wangyjlb@cardb104 w on w.vc_wangyjlbid = rp.vc_wangyjlbid left join hengyuncar.t_wf_code te on te.codevalue = w.vc_wangygs and te.typevalue = 'vc_suosgs' left join hengyuncar.cy_op_spbzjwyglb wybzj on wybzj.vc_wangybh = w.vc_wangybh ) t
